=== graph-api ===
[/app/.venv/bin/uvicorn] | CMD=[graph_api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000] | WD=/app
=== request-proxy ===
[/app/.venv/bin/request_proxy] | CMD=[--host 0.0.0.0] | WD=
=== kommentar-service ===
[] | CMD=[uv run uvicorn src.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000] | WD=/app
=== xoev-adapter ===
[/app/.venv/bin/xoev-adapter] | CMD=[--host 0.0.0.0] | WD=

observation.command: cd /workspace && for img in graph-api request-proxy kommentar-service xoev-adapter; do echo "=== $img ==="; docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Entrypoint}} | CMD={{.Config.Cmd}} | WD={{.Config.WorkingDir}}' $img:latest 2>&1; done
